subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Cargo Bikes
description: A short lesson to help you apply Cargo Bikes.

hook.text: A cargo bike weaves through traffic and delivers 40 packages in the time a van delivers 20. No parking needed.

buildup.text: Electric cargo bikes carry 100–250 kg of goods through city streets faster than vans in congested areas.

discovery.text: They produce zero emissions, need no parking, and access pedestrian zones that ban motor vehicles.

twist.text: Cargo bikes are limited by payload and weather. Heavy, bulky, or fragile items still need a van.

climax.text: DHL, UPS, and Amazon all use cargo bikes in European cities. Adoption is growing fast.

punchline.text: Two wheels, zero emissions, full speed in city traffic.

quiz.question: What advantage do cargo bikes have over vans in cities?
options: No parking needed and access to pedestrian zones
